correctness.rationale: Resource reduction, exact logistic period-two roots, and triangular linearization are derived directly from the model. The exact eigenvalues are Lambda_n=4+2mu-mu^2 and Lambda_C=[alpha^2+(mu+1)(mu-2)alpha sigma+(mu+1)sigma^2]/mu^2. Their strict magnitudes prove attraction/saddle behavior; monotonicity proves uniqueness of the transverse threshold; the variance identity gives the strict mean-game gap. Exact symbolic checks and a rational witness were successfully replayed. Excludes equality and global claims.

value.rationale: A published eco-evolutionary model invokes mean-game approximation under resource oscillations. The nontrivial correction establishes when average payoff makes a qualitatively wrong cooperator-invasion prediction, gives a sharp parameter transition and an explicit open physical counterregime, uniformly across two different discrete replicator conventions. This is a motivated structural/local ecological result rather than an arbitrary table computation.
